				always = yes

		}

	on_activate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                c:USA ?= root
                country_has_primary_culture = cu:afro_american
            }
            remove_primary_culture = cu:afro_american
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                c:USA ?= root
                NOT = {
                    country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
                }
            }
            add_primary_culture = cu:dixie
        }
    }

		recalculate_pop_ig_support = yes

	}
